var itemStatus = "";
if(msg.payload.SearchOption.List === true &&msg.payload.SearchOption.Finish === false)
{
   itemStatus = `and Mdata.itemStatus in ('LIST NORMAL','LIST RECHECK','LIST RECONFIRM')`;
}
else if(msg.payload.SearchOption.List === false &&msg.payload.SearchOption.Finish === true)
{
  itemStatus= `and Mdata.itemStatus in ('FINISH NORMAL','FINISH RECHECK','FINISH RECONFIRM')`;
}
else
{
   itemStatus = `and Mdata.itemStatus in ('LIST NORMAL','FINISH NORMAL','LIST RECHECK','FINISH RECHECK','LIST RECONFIRM','FINISH RECONFIRM')`;
}
msg.payload = `select
Mdata.[ID] as RequestSample_ID,
Mdata.[ReqNo],
Mdata.[JobType],
Mdata.[Incharge],
Mdata.[Branch],
Mdata.[RequestSection],
Mdata.[ReqDate],
Mdata.[CustFull],
Mdata.[SampleCode],
Mdata.[SampleGroup],
Mdata.[SampleType],
Mdata.[SampleTank],
Mdata.[SampleName],
Mdata.[SamplingDate],
Mdata.[AnalysisDueDate],
Mdata.[SampleRemark],
Mdata.[SampleAttachFile],
Mdata.[Position],
Mdata.[Mag],
Mdata.[Temp],
Mdata.[StdFactor],
Mdata.[StdMaxL] as StdMax,
Mdata.[StdMinL] as StdMin,
Mdata.[ItemNo],
Mdata.[ItemName],
Mdata.[RemarkNo],
Mdata.[ItemStatus],
Idata.[UserAnalysis],
Idata.[UserAnalysisBranch],
Idata.[AnalysisDate],
Idata.[ResultSymbol_1],
Idata.[Result_1],
Idata.[ResultUnit_1],
Idata.[ResultRemark_1],
Idata.[ResultFile_1],
Idata.[ResultSymbol_2],
Idata.[Result_2],
Idata.[ResultUnit_2],
Idata.[ResultRemark_2],
Idata.[ResultFile_2]
FROM Routine_RequestLab as Mdata
LEFT JOIN  Instrument_FA as Idata
ON Idata.[RequestSample_ID] = Mdata.ID
and Idata.[ItemStatus] = Mdata.[ItemStatus]
where Mdata.[userListAnalysis] = '${msg.payload.UserName}'
${itemStatus}
and Mdata.Instrumentname = '${msg.payload.InstrumentName}'
and Mdata.RemarkNo like '%${msg.payload.SearchOption.RemarkNo}%'
and Mdata.SampleCode like '%${msg.payload.SearchOption.SampleCode}%'
order by Mdata.remarkNO asc,Mdata.ReqNo asc,Mdata.SampleNo asc,Mdata.ItemNo asc;`
;return msg;

name: Query Text
func:
var data = msg.payload.data;
var query = "";
var dt = global.get('DateTime');

// ผลของหน้านี้เก็บเป็นทศนิยม 1 ตำแหน่งเสมอ
// ค่าที่ไม่ใช่ตัวเลข (ช่องว่าง หรือ error เช่น DELIVERY ERROR) คงไว้ตามเดิม
function toFixed1(v)
{
    if(v === null || v === undefined || v === '' || isNaN(v))
    {
        return (v === null || v === undefined) ? '' : v;
    }
    return parseFloat(v).toFixed(1);
}

data[0].Result_1 = toFixed1(data[0].Result_1);
data[0].Result_2 = toFixed1(data[0].Result_2);

var statusForDel = '';
if(data[0].ItemStatus == "LIST NORMAL" || data[0].ItemStatus == "FINISH NORMAL")
{
    statusForDel = `itemstatus in ('LIST NORMAL','FINISH NORMAL')`;
}
else if(data[0].ItemStatus == "LIST RECHECK" || data[0].ItemStatus == "FINISH RECHECK")
{
    statusForDel = `itemstatus in ('LIST RECHECK','FINISH RECHECK')`;
}
else
{
    statusForDel = `itemstatus in ('LIST RECONFIRM','FINISH RECONFIRM')`;
}

var query2 = `
delete from Instrument_FA where RequestSample_ID = '${data[0].RequestSample_ID}' and ${statusForDel};
Insert into Instrument_FA (RequestSample_ID,
ReqNo,
JobType,
Incharge,
Branch,
RequestSection,
ReqDate,
CustFull,
SampleCode,
SampleGroup,
SampleType,
SampleTank,
SampleName,
SamplingDate,
AnalysisDueDate,
SampleRemark,
SampleAttachFile,
Position,
Mag,
Temp,
StdFactor,
StdMax,
StdMin,
ItemNo,
ItemName,
RemarkNo,
ItemStatus,
UserAnalysis,
UserAnalysisBranch,
AnalysisDate,
[ResultSymbol_1]
,[Result_1]
,[ResultUnit_1]
,[ResultRemark_1]
,[ResultFile_1]
,[ResultSymbol_2]
,[Result_2]
,[ResultUnit_2]
,[ResultRemark_2]
,[ResultFile_2]
) values
('${data[0].RequestSample_ID}',
'${data[0].ReqNo}',
'${data[0].JobType}',
'${data[0].Incharge}',
'${data[0].Branch}',
'${data[0].RequestSection}',
'${(data[0].ReqDate).slice(0, 19).replace('T', ' ')}',
'${data[0].CustFull}',
'${data[0].SampleCode}',
'${data[0].SampleGroup}',
'${data[0].SampleType}',
'${data[0].SampleTank}',
'${data[0].SampleName}',
'${(data[0].SamplingDate).split("/").reverse().join("-")}',
'${(data[0].AnalysisDueDate).split("/").reverse().join("-")}',
'${data[0].SampleRemark}',
'${data[0].SampleAttachFile}',
'${data[0].Position}',
'${data[0].Mag}',
'${data[0].Temp}',
'${data[0].StdFactor}',
'${data[0].StdMax}',
'${data[0].StdMin}',
'${data[0].ItemNo}',
'${data[0].ItemName}',
'${data[0].RemarkNo}',
'${data[0].ItemStatus}',
'${data[0].UserAnalysis}',
'${data[0].UserAnalysisBranch}',
'${dt}',
'${data[0].ResultSymbol_1}',
'${data[0].Result_1}',
'${data[0].ResultUnit_1}',
'${data[0].ResultRemark_1}',
'${data[0].ResultFile_1}',
'${data[0].ResultSymbol_2}',
'${data[0].Result_2}',
'${data[0].ResultUnit_2}',
'${data[0].ResultRemark_2}',
'${data[0].ResultFile_2}');
`;

msg.payload = query2;

return msg;
